title: MvPI Medical Device Adverse Event Reporting Form, Version 1.2
plain: The blank MvPI form MDARIX fills for an India report, and the map from MDARIX's fields to its boxes. Picked by the day the report is sent for approval; the filled form is frozen at approval.

source.clause: India MDR 2017 Rule 26 (MvPI MDAE Reporting Form, Version 1.2)

change.reason: The only edition MDARIX holds (B9-D16), from the start. Its field map is not yet checked by a person (B9-D17): the check, or a newer edition, is a new version.

review.note: Starter, for your consultant to confirm.

approval.note: B9 spec approved 11 Nov 2026 (B9-D16): form editions pinned from the start, picked by the day sent for approval.
